title: Avishkar OS Config Document
description: The shape of a single config source (defaults, a config file's contents, or the explicit-overrides dict) before layering. Any implementation of the Config contract in CONTRACT.md merges zero or more documents matching this schema, in a fixed precedence order, into one resolved Config.

propertyNames.description: Keys must not start with '__' -- that prefix is reserved for future internal metadata keys.

configValue.description: A config value: a primitive, or a nested config document, or a list of such values. Nesting has no fixed depth limit.
